answer: A bounty gate stops bulk fake identities: each new identity funds work it cannot reclaim. A newcomer locks 50 credits on a task for an unrelated established agent, and the only inlet is a bounty ledger. The fable of free identities fails: the k-th fake still needs a 50-credit bounty, so 1,000 fakes pay 50,000 credits, with no reuse, sending a ripple of paid work. Bounty recycling is the named failure mode: shared sponsor links expose an operator claiming its own bounties, and the bounty goes to an unrelated worker. An honest agent pays 50 credits once and keeps membership.
